nodes.title: hissa pour (fit, part, deci): the child says how many full cups the jug will fill before the first pour, and the run grades that count. Pour and Run are refused until a count is said. Once a cup is poured the count stands (undo keeps it) until the run answers. A wrong count misses, as the kit belief where one maps (the mal-rules are now in the count said). Why: games audit GAMES-08, where pour × 8 then Run solved every served pour level, clean and correct, and the child never decided a count. Supersedes the line in dc-r7-games-hissa that said pouring every full cup IS the division. Reverse if: a child pilot shows the count is read off the jug's cup marks at fades 1 and 2 without counting (then hide the marks until the first pour).

One-decision play goals (galti-pakdo pakdo, hissa grid/shift, nazariya tri/more, kon zone/kind) enter a CORRECT outcome at CHANCE_WEIGHT 0.25. This is the arena's chance-adjusted weight: GAME_WEIGHT 0.5 × the controllerEasy temper. Incorrect and partial outcomes stay at GAME_WEIGHT. One mechanism: FamilyLogic.oneDecision (per-goal), read in gradeLevel where the row weight is set; playKtEvents folds a CHANCE_WEIGHT row as controllerEasy. Why: games audit GAMES-03, where a random first tap lands these goals 14 to 41 % of the time. A second decision bolted on would make them a quiz in costume. Hissa pour is not marked, because after the count fix random tapping lands it 0.3 to 1.3 %. Reverse if: a goal gains a second real decision, or measured first-try luck on it falls under about 5 %.

Games audit play-family replay, hissa, galti-pakdo, nazariya and kon (200 random act lists per level, 18 levels per entry, no network or DB), before and after the fix. Hissa pour any-win / first-try luck: fit 43.7 / 24.5 % → 1.8 / 0.9 %; part 42.6 / 29.7 % → 2.4 / 1.3 %; deci 42.6 / 23.5 % → 0.4 / 0.3 %. The chance-weighted goals' rates are unchanged by design, and their lucky corrects now carry weight 0.25 instead of 0.5: galti pakdo 48.1 / 41.4 %, hissa shift 13.9 / 13.5 %, tri more 30.2 / 26.0 %, kon kind 16.4 / 10.3 %.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-hissa-pour-count`

**hissa pour now grades a committed count** (games audit GAMES-08, 2026-11-10).

- **Before:** tapping Pour until the jug refused, then Run, solved every served pour level, clean and with evidence `correct`. The served levels all had remainder 0, so pouring to the brim was the whole answer, and the child never decided a count.
- **Now:** the child first says how many full cups (glasses) the jug will fill, on a − ? + stepper (act `{ kind: "count", n }`, 0..20).
  - Pour and Run are refused until a count is said (`count_first`).
  - Once a cup is poured the count stands: an undo of the pours does not take it back (`said`). The run then answers.
  - The run needs the count said = the cups that fit = the cups poured, and the part-cup tag right.
  - A wrong count misses. The mal-rules (div-smaller, no-flip, flip-first, div-half, scale-one) are now set-ups of the count said plus the tag, so a wrong count matching a belief folds that kit id.
  - After a missed run the count may be said again; the evidence keeps the first miss.
- **Unchanged:** pouring is still how the child sees it, and nothing is timed.
- **Fades:** at fades 1 and 2 the jug's cup marks are drawn, so a child can count them before saying. That is the scaffold, and fade 3 is bare.
- **Supersedes** the line in `dc-r7-games-hissa` that says pouring every full cup IS the division and is no shortcut.
- **Reverse if** a pilot shows the count is read off the marks without counting.

## `dc-r7-play-one-decision-weight`

**One-decision play goals grade a correct outcome at the arena's chance-adjusted weight** (games audit GAMES-03, 2026-11-10).

- **Goals:** galti-pakdo `pakdo`, hissa grid `shift`, nazariya tri `more` and kon zone `kind`. Each is one pick, which a lucky first tap lands 14 to 41 % of the time in the audit's random-tapping model.
- **Weights:** their `correct` rows carry `CHANCE_WEIGHT` = 0.25 (shared/play.ts), which is GAME_WEIGHT × the controllerEasy temper 0.5: exactly how arena evidence enters. `incorrect` and `partial` rows stay at GAME_WEIGHT, because a miss is not luck.
- **Mechanism:** one per-goal marker, `FamilyLogic.oneDecision`, read by `gradeLevel` (src/play/core/replay.ts) where the evidence weight is set. `playKtEvents` (server/play/evidence.js) folds a signed CHANCE_WEIGHT row with `controllerEasy: true`, so kt/bktr.js tempers it to 0.25.
- **Why not a second decision:** a "why" pick or a second card bolted onto these levels would make them a quiz in costume, and the arena already uses this weighting.
- **Hissa pour is not marked:** after the count fix its count is a free choice among 0..20, said before the jug shows it, and the part-cup must be right too. Random tapping lands it 0.3 to 1.3 %.
- **Reverse if** a goal gains a second real decision, or its measured first-try luck falls under about 5 %.
md.measurements:
## `ms-r7-audit-games-03-08-replay`

Games audit `play-family.mjs` (branch claude/r7-audit-games), 2026-11-10.

- **Method:** run over hissa, galti-pakdo, nazariya and kon with `--trials 200`, DATABASE_URL blank. Each entry plays 18 levels (fades 1-3 × garam/teekha × 3 seeds), with 200 random act lists per level drawn from the solver's own act shapes. Rates are per goal: "any win" is a win after misses; "luck" is a first-try `correct`.
- **Before → after.** Hissa pour:
  - fit (3600 trials): any-win 43.7 → 1.8 %, luck 24.5 → 0.9 %.
  - part (3600): any-win 42.6 → 2.4 %, luck 29.7 → 1.3 %.
  - deci (3600): any-win 42.6 → 0.4 %, luck 23.5 → 0.3 %.
- **Chance-weighted goals:** rates are unchanged by design. The weight of their lucky corrects moves 0.5 → 0.25:
  - galti pakdo: any-win 48.1 %, luck 41.4 % (3600 trials).
  - hissa shift: 13.9 % / 13.5 % (7200).
  - nazariya tri more: 30.2 % / 26.0 % (3600).
  - kon zone kind: 16.4 % / 10.3 % (10800).
- **UI:** the pour count was driven by real taps at 360 × 640 in en, hi and hinglish. 39 of 39 checks pass (targets ≥ 44 px, text ≥ 16 px, 0 clipped labels or goal lines, 0 overflow, 0 errors): docs/design/round7/games/runshots-hissa/.
